title: My first game is nearly out on mobile! (Godot + Claude + Gemini)
author: Ukawok92
selftext:
Been working on my first game called Puzzle Rush. It's currently in closed beta on Android, should be public in about one week. (If anyone is interested in joining the closed beta, let me know I'll invite you)

Been working on it for about 3 months, using Godot as the engine, claude code (mostly opus 5.5 lately) and Gemini for music/art and a little Blender.

Some of the features:

\- 12 VS Bosses with 3D worlds  
\- Endless + Time Trial w/ Leaderboards & Replays  
\- Puzzle Mode + Create & Share Community feature  
\- Full controller support, or virtual buttons/swipe controls

I'm really happy with how it's turned out. It's crazy how far its come from the first build.

I had Claude help create this trailer then finished it up in final cut pro.

replies.author: Ukawok92
replies.body:
I have thought about trying different symbols on the blocks to match the space theme. Like a spaceship on one, keep the star, the circle can be a planets add a shooting star. Yeah I'll add that soon.

I think I kept with the basic shapes since they are clearly visually distinct from each other, but the colors are probably enough.
